title: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.36405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work.   A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent.   We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five

translated_title: kw-bench：用真实世界任务击穿前沿智能体运行框架
translated_abstract: 每一代新的前沿模型都在不断拓展可能性的边界。在一个运行框架（harness）中——包含一个循环、一个 shell、一个文件系统，以及编写并运行自身代码的能力——模型能够承担越来越困难的工作。越来越多的研究将编码智能体的运行框架视为知识工作的基础设施，而非单纯的编码工具，新一波的基准测试也正是在这一场景下对其进行检验。这些基准大多是生成式的：根据简报构建财务模型、备忘录或电子表格，并由评分标准或另一个模型来评判。然而，很少有基准去测试知识工作中最昂贵的部分，即调查性工作。在审计、税务、尽职调查、监管报告、理赔或任何涉及数字的争议中，答案其实早已存在——只是隐藏在散布于各个系统之中、不完整且相互矛盾的证据里——必须将其还原出来，并精确到分地加以论证。我们推出了 kw-bench，这是一个基于专业人士向我们描述的真实业务委托所构建的基准。它的第一个任务族是一个五……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: kw-bench 是基于真实业务委托构建的基准，首次将评估重点从生成式任务转向审计、税务等知识工作中的调查性环节，检验前沿智能体运行框架能否从不完整、不一致的分散证据中精确还原并论证答案。
en_tdlr: kw-bench is a benchmark built from real specialist engagements that shifts evaluation from generative tasks to the investigative core of knowledge work, testing whether frontier agent harnesses can recover and defend answers hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence across systems.
